tools.name: create_meeting_poll
tools.description: Agentic tool to create a new meeting scheduling poll in Candidate Slots mode (slots) or Drag-to-Paint Availability Grid mode (grid), with candidate dates, time slots or earliest/latest range, duration/block size, and optional invitee emails

tools.name: get_poll_consensus
tools.description: Analyze vote distribution and calculate optimal meeting slot with percentage agreement, voter breakdown, and AI scheduling recommendations

tools.name: submit_participant_vote
tools.description: Submit availability votes (with optional "If Need Be" backup slots and email receipt) for a participant on candidate meeting slots or grid blocks

tools.name: get_platform_pricing_and_plans
tools.description: Retrieve MeetingPoll subscription plans, single-poll passes, organization quorum plans, and free features

tools.name: check_poll_status
tools.description: Inspect a poll by ID or vanity slug to view poll mode, candidate schedule, response counts, and active state

title: Tool description changed since last scan
